value.rationale: The natural first nontrivial-period problem for a well-studied delay family is completely classified across all integer delay pairs by parity, including explicit exceptional continua and singular creation at infinity versus from a finite continuum. The even-k odd-d trichotomy is a robust structural bifurcation law not visible in the model’s fixed-point stability results; existence is not falsely promoted to attraction.
